task.title: Disable background git maintenance in bare test origins to stop macOS TempDir cleanup races
task.description: The first CI run on main (run 31188304081, merge of PR #29) failed on macos-15 only: TestPushOmitsInvalidTaskButPublishesIndependentValidTask passed its assertions but t.TempDir cleanup failed with 'unlinkat .../origin.git: directory not empty'. Bare origin fixtures are created with plain git init --bare and no maintenance suppression, so receive-pack can detach a background git gc --auto that outlives the test and races TempDir RemoveAll; slower macOS runners lose the race while ubuntu wins it. Fix: configure receive.autogc=false, gc.auto=0, and maintenance.auto=false on bare origin fixtures in internal/gitstore/sync_test.go, internal/cli/sync_test.go, and scripts/publish_release_test.go. The perf fixture bare origins (internal/perf) are deliberately left as real-repo models and are excluded. Found 2026-08-07 watching the first push CI run on main.
